entities.canonical_name: Unnamed associate managing fuel station in Chopra's absence
Parked vehicle near district bus stand

relationships.description: Ahmed handed Chopra a small wrapped bundle at a roadside tea stall with no source contact present.
Ansari, positively identified for the first time, met Chopra at the fuel station's back office.
Ansari met both Chopra and Ahmed together at the fuel station's back office during the same twenty-minute window.
Chopra approached a parked vehicle associated with the source contact and spoke briefly through the window.
Ahmed separately approached the same parked vehicle and spoke briefly with the occupant within twenty minutes of Chopra's exchange.
Chopra, during questioning, disclosed that 'the source contact' is Iqbal Ansari, corroborating the earlier surveillance identification.
Ansari met Ahmed and the fuel-station-linked associate together at a lodge, handing Ahmed a small bag.
Ansari addressed both Ahmed and the fuel-station-linked associate together at the lodge meeting.
Ahmed and the associate met directly near the fuel station's rear gate to settle an exchange, without the source contact present.
Ansari met Ahmed and the associate together at a roadside dhaba, addressing both directly.
Ansari addressed the associate alongside Ahmed at the dhaba meeting, gesturing toward the associate's vehicle.

timeline.event_summary: Surveillance observed routine activity at the fuel station and a brief unclear meeting in the back office.
An informant assessed the trader who received a fake note as a legitimate customer unconnected to the network.
An FIR was registered based on a trader's complaint about a fake note, pointing investigators toward the fuel-station front.
Surveillance recorded Ahmed handing Chopra a bundle directly at a tea stall with no third party present.
Surveillance positively identified the source contact as Iqbal Ansari meeting both Chopra and Ahmed at the fuel station's back office.
A follow-up FIR recorded continued informant input on the network's circulation activity via the fuel station.
Surveillance recorded both Chopra and Ahmed separately receiving instruction from the source contact at a parked vehicle.
Chopra was apprehended at the fuel station, while Ansari and Ahmed remained at large.
Chopra disclosed during questioning that the source contact's real identity is Iqbal Ansari.
Surveillance recorded Ansari meeting Ahmed and a new fuel-station associate together at a lodge.
An informant reported Ahmed and the associate meeting directly to settle an exchange, without the source contact present.
A follow-up FIR recorded the fuel station's altered operating pattern and noted Ansari's number had gone silent.
Surveillance recorded Ansari meeting Ahmed and the associate together at a roadside dhaba.
A tip about an unrelated general store circulating fake notes was verified and found to have no connection to the network.
An informant reported continued reduced-schedule operations at the fuel station and that the source contact was avoiding known locations.
Ahmed was apprehended, leaving Ansari as the sole network figure still at large.

red_herrings.reason_excluded: Assessed as a legitimate customer who unknowingly received a fake note with no connection to the fuel-station front or any individual under investigation.
Field verification found no irregularity in the store's records and no connection to the network; the tip was based on an unconfirmed rumour.
